claims.text: Many reviewers report that the product helps them fall asleep faster and sleep more soundly.
Reviewers say it works more gently than melatonin pills, without grogginess or a drugged feeling the next day.
Several users mention muscle relaxation and relief from cramping, soreness, or aches.
Some reviewers note the product is expensive but still consider it effective.
A few reviewers address skin feel, with some reporting itchiness or oiliness while others found neither to be an issue.

qa.q: Will this help me fall asleep faster?
qa.answer: Yes, some reviewers report falling asleep faster, with one saying they "find myself falling asleep so much faster" [2] and another noting they "didn't even know I fell asleep" [1]. Other reviews describe better or deeper sleep quality rather than speed specifically [3][5][6].

claims.text: One reviewer reports falling asleep much faster after applying it before bed [2].
Another reviewer says they didn't even realize they fell asleep [1].
Other reviewers describe improved sleep quality or sleeping more soundly rather than faster sleep onset [3][5][6].

qa.q: Does it leave a greasy or sticky feeling on the skin?
qa.answer: Reviews say it does not feel greasy or sticky: one notes it applies without the sticky feeling of magnesium oil [2], and another says it isn't greasy feeling [3]. One review mentions others claimed it left skin itchy or oily, but that reviewer found neither to be an issue [1].

claims.text: It applies easily without the sticky feeling one would get with magnesium oil [2].
Some others stated it leaves skin feeling itchy or oily, but that reviewer found neither to be an issue [1].

qa.q: Can I use this every night safely?
qa.answer: Reviews report nightly use without grogginess or harsh effects [3], and one reviewer uses it as part of a bedtime routine [4]. However, no review explicitly addresses long-term safety of nightly use.

claims.text: A reviewer and their husband use the cream nightly and describe it as gentle with no grogginess the next day.
A reviewer uses it as part of a nightly bedtime routine.

qa.q: Does it have a strong smell?
qa.answer: One reviewer describes it as having no strong odor and being odor free [1], but no other reviews address the smell.

claims.text: It has no strong odor and is odor free.

qa.q: Is it safe to use with other sleep supplements or melatonin pills?
qa.answer: Not enough evidence in reviews to answer this.
